fields.title: LinkedIn article record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of LinkedIn's public long-form article data. One ARTICLE row per article, an optional SUMMARY row for the run, NOTICE rows for surfaces LinkedIn closes to logged-out visitors, and ERROR rows on failure. LinkedIn changes its markup without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The article URL or author profile that produced this record.

_source.title: Source surface
_source.description: guest-pulse-article, guest-profile-page, or none on NOTICE and ERROR rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: fetch_failed, auth_required or discovery_failed.

_notice.title: Notice
_notice.description: newsletter_series_closed when a /newsletters/ URL was passed, not_an_article when a URL resolved to something else.

_noticeDetail.title: Notice detail
_noticeDetail.description: What the notice means and what to change.

articleTitle.title: Title
articleTitle.description: The article's title. Note LinkedIn stores this in the JSON-LD 'name' field while 'headline' holds the opening excerpt - the opposite of what those names suggest.

articleUrl.title: Article URL
articleUrl.description: Canonical /pulse/ link with tracking parameters stripped.

articleSlug.title: Article slug
articleSlug.description: The slug out of the URL - a stable key to join on.

excerpt.title: Excerpt
excerpt.description: The opening lines LinkedIn uses as the article preview.

articleText.title: Full text
articleText.description: The complete article body as plain text, with LinkedIn's title, byline and 'Report this article' chrome trimmed off. Omitted when you turn full text off.

wordCount.title: Word count
wordCount.description: Words in the body - the input to reading time, and a useful axis when asking whether long or short pieces perform better for an author.

readingTimeMinutes.title: Reading time
readingTimeMinutes.description: Estimated minutes at 225 words per minute.

modifiedAt.title: Last edited
modifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 last-edit timestamp, when the author revised the piece after publishing.

authorUrl.title: Author profile
authorUrl.description: Their LinkedIn profile, tracking parameters stripped.

authorSlug.title: Author slug
authorSlug.description: Their handle - the key to group an author's articles on.

authorFollowers.title: Author followers
authorFollowers.description: Follower count at scrape time - the denominator behind engagementPerThousand.

engagementPerThousand.title: Reactions per 1,000 followers
engagementPerThousand.description: Reactions divided by the author's followers, times a thousand. The figure that makes articles by authors of very different sizes comparable - raw reaction counts only tell you who has the bigger list.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Hashtags used in the body, lowercased.

externalLinks.title: External links
externalLinks.description: URLs linked from the body - useful for seeing who an author cites or promotes.

isAccessibleForFree.title: Free to read
isAccessibleForFree.description: LinkedIn's own flag for whether the piece is gated.

commentSample.title: Comment sample
commentSample.description: When comment sampling is on: the commenters LinkedIn renders on the public page - roughly the first 8 - with name, profile link and comment text. Arrives in the same page load, so it costs no extra request.

commentSampleSize.title: Comments sampled
commentSampleSize.description: How many comments were captured. Always far below the true 'comments' total: LinkedIn publishes only the first handful to logged-out visitors.

articlesAnalysed.title: Articles analysed
articlesAnalysed.description: SUMMARY row: how many articles this run read.

medianReactions.title: Median reactions
medianReactions.description: SUMMARY row: median reactions across the run - more honest than the mean, which one viral piece distorts.

avgReactions.title: Average reactions
avgReactions.description: SUMMARY row: mean reactions across the run.

medianWordCount.title: Median word count
medianWordCount.description: SUMMARY row: typical article length across the run.

topHashtags.title: Top hashtags
topHashtags.description: SUMMARY row: most-used hashtags across everything read - a quick read on which topics an author or field is pushing.

authors.title: Authors
authors.description: SUMMARY row: every author represented in the run.
